prepared_by: Codex collecting agent (single reviewer); independent reviewer assigned

vulnerability.title: Jenkins does not mask password fields rendered under a view, exposing the encrypted secret to users with View/Read

fixed_releases.verified_content: The 2.541 release commit ea9c7278 has the SECURITY-1809 commit 3ee7380c as an ancestor (git merge-base --is-ancestor exits 0), and Functions.java at the tag is blob fbd5e8a6, the same blob as at 3ee7380c. The 2.528.3 release commit 40e29179 has the LTS backport 042de664 as an ancestor, and Functions.java at that tag is blob 10ebf6f7, the same blob as at 042de664. In both fixed trees Functions.getPasswordValue walks the request's ancestor chain and masks the value when the closest Item, Computer or View ancestor lacks CONFIGURE. The regression test Security1809Test asserts that a View/Read-only user sees ******** where a View/Read+View/Configure user sees the encrypted value.

severity.numeric_level_rationale: NVD publishes a single CVSS 3.1 metric, 4.3 MEDIUM, from the Secondary source (CISA-ADP); there is no Primary metric. OSV/GHSA repeats the same 4.3 vector and records MODERATE, which is the same medium band. The CNA container has no CVSS metric. Every published severity level is medium, so the level is consistent and the score is not averaged.

vulnerability.category_l2: The f:password renderer decides masking from Item and Computer ancestors only, so when the control is rendered under a View no Configure check is applied and a View/Read-only user receives the encrypted secret value

description: Jenkins renders secret form fields through Functions.getPasswordValue, which backs the <f:password/> Jelly tag. At 2.441 the masking decision (lines 2150-2163) looks up only an Item ancestor and a Computer ancestor of the current request; if the closest such ancestor lacks CONFIGURE it returns ********, otherwise it falls through and returns Secret.getEncryptedValue() (2166-2168). Views are not part of that decision. When a password control is rendered on a view page - for example a view configuration page, the primary view, or a view-scoped action - the request has no Item or Computer ancestor, so no mask is applied and a user holding View/Read receives the encrypted Secret value on the page. Obtainable encrypted values are not equivalent to masking: the value is the stored Secret ciphertext rather than the placeholder, which the advisory treats as disclosure of encrypted password values. The 2.541/2.528.3 fix commits 3ee7380c and 042de664 replace the two lookups with a reverse walk over req.getAncestors() that checks the closest Item, Computer or View ancestor's CONFIGURE permission and masks when it is absent; the old two-lookup behavior is kept behind the nonRecursivePasswordMaskingPermissionCheck system property. Security1809Test adds a PasswordView that renders a Secret through f:password and asserts that the View/Read-only user sees ******** while the View/Read+View/Configure user sees the encrypted value (passwordIsMaskedForView, passwordIsMaskedForPrimaryView), plus agent, job, closest-ancestor and nested-folder cases.

critical_operation.description: The mask decision consults only Item and Computer ancestors. A password control rendered under a View has neither, so the method skips both checks and returns the encrypted Secret at 2167 for a user who holds View/Read but not View/Configure.

entry_point.description: HTTP GET of a Jenkins page whose request ancestor chain contains a View but no Item or Computer, and whose Jelly template renders a Secret through <f:password/> (for example a view configuration page or a view-scoped action), as a user holding Overall/Read and View/Read but not View/Configure.

source_crosscheck.notes: The CNA, NVD, OSV and the GitHub advisory agree on the mechanism (password fields rendered under a view are not masked for users without View/Configure) and on the fixed releases (2.541 weekly, 2.528.3 LTS). NVD publishes no Primary metric; its only metric is the CISA-ADP Secondary 4.3 MEDIUM, which OSV/GHSA repeats as 4.3 MODERATE, and the CNA has no metric, so all published levels are medium. CWE-862 is recorded by NVD's Secondary source and by GHSA; the CNA lists none. The GHSA ECOSYSTEM weekly range introduced=2.529 conflicts with the CNA text and the CVE GIT range (introduced 0); this dataset follows the CNA and GIT range and records the conflict. The earlier view config.xml redaction work (SECURITY-3496 / CVE-2025-27623, fixed in 2.500) is a different code path (View.doConfigDotXml) and a different advisory item; this dossier claims only the f:password masking decision in Functions.getPasswordValue.

required_before_promotion: An independent reviewer must read Functions.getPasswordValue at 2.441 and confirm the mask decision consults only Item and Computer ancestors and falls through to the encrypted value for View-scoped requests.
An independent reviewer must confirm the fix commits 3ee7380c/042de664 add the View-aware ancestor walk and are contained in releases 2.541 and 2.528.3.
An independent reviewer must confirm the affected range (weekly <=2.540, LTS <=2.528.2) and that 2.441 is inside it.
An independent reviewer must confirm all published severity levels are medium (4.3) and record CWE-862.
An independent reviewer must confirm this entry is distinct from CVE-2025-27622 and CVE-2025-27623, and from CVE-2025-31720 and CVE-2025-31721.
No formal reviews.jsonl row may be written until a named independent reviewer returns a verdict.

limitations: Static verification only; no Jenkins instance, HTTP request or test was run.

Whether a stock Jenkins 2.441 page renders an f:password control under a View without an Item or Computer ancestor was not demonstrated dynamically; the fix's own regression test constructs such a view (PasswordView) and the advisory states the issue affects views, which is the basis for accepting the precondition.
The disclosure is of the encrypted Secret value, not the plaintext; the dataset records the impact exactly as the advisory does (view encrypted password values) and does not claim plaintext recovery.
The GHSA ECOSYSTEM weekly range introduced=2.529 conflicts with the CNA and the CVE GIT range; the conflict is documented, not resolved silently.
open_questions: Which plugins render password controls directly under a view in the 2.441 era was not enumerated; the advisory and the regression test establish the class of pages.
